mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0% sustained for 3 consecutive months increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained RSAFS above its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 (thousands of units) signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and construction activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained INDPRO above 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
